findings.title: Frozen t and F tail probabilities collapse to exact zero
findings.formula_or_invariant: Two-sided p=2*P(T_df>=abs(t)) and right-tail p=P(F>=f); manifest reject_zero_mismatch requires representable nonzero tails not to become zero.
reproduction_steps: Export commit 0242978e7add4a7d44ab2056c4cbc9657f24a5f9 src/tabra into a temporary directory with git archive.
Run validation/commands/reg/python/run.py with PYTHONPATH pointing to the exported src tree and the frozen fixture.
Run validation/commands/reg/oracles/code_audit_oracle.py against that result; observe exit 1 and zero_mismatch=true for both p-value metrics.
findings.disposition: OPEN. The dirty worktree survival-function edit is not part of the frozen commit; freeze a repaired revision and rerun the full code audit.

findings.title: Normal-equations LU solve is scale-dependent and lacks rank/conditioning safeguards
findings.formula_or_invariant: For nonzero scalar c, uniformly replacing X by cX preserves rank and cond(X), and fitted values from OLS must be invariant after reciprocal coefficient scaling.
affected_cases: any full-rank design with small units or near-collinearity

evidence.scaled_outcome: ValueError: Matrix is singular, cannot perform LU decomposition

reproduction_steps: Create a no-constant two-column full-rank design from linspace(-1,1,30) and sin(arange(30)).
Fit once at original units and once after multiplying both X columns by 1e-8.
Verify both matrices have rank 2 and cond(X)=1.1761; observe the scaled fit raises the LU singularity ValueError.
findings.disposition: OPEN. Use a rank-revealing numerically stable solve with scale-relative rank/condition policy and explicit diagnostics; then rerun the audit.

findings.title: Non-finite and overflow inputs can return invalid estimates
findings.formula_or_invariant: Estimator inputs and all returned coefficients, covariance entries, statistics, and probabilities must be finite or estimation must fail explicitly.
affected_cases: public reg inputs containing Inf or overflowing products

evidence.infinity_probe: returned NaN coefficients, standard errors, t statistics, p-values, F statistic, and F p-value
evidence.overflow_probe: returned coefficient [0.0, 2.5], NaN slope p-value, F=0.0, and F p=1.0

reproduction_steps: Fit y=[1,2,3,4] on x=[0,1,Inf,3] with a constant and inspect result arrays.
Fit the same y on x=[1e200,2e200,3e200,4e200] and inspect warnings and result finiteness.
findings.disposition: OPEN. Validate finite inputs and finite intermediate/output arrays, raising a specific estimation error before returning a result.

findings.title: Degenerate degrees of freedom and zero variance produce false or undefined inference
findings.formula_or_invariant: Classical covariance requires df_resid=n-k>0; an F test requires df_model>0 and positive residual variance. Undefined tests must not be reported with p=0.

evidence.zero_response: returned zero standard errors, NaN t/p values, F=0.0, and F p=0.0
evidence.intercept_only: returned df_model=0, F=0.0, and F p=0.0

reproduction_steps: Fit a full-rank 2x2 no-constant design and observe division by zero at RSS/(n-k).
Fit a zero response on a varying regressor with a constant and inspect NaN coefficient tests plus F p=0.
Fit a nonconstant response with x=[] and a constant and observe df_model=0 but F p=0.
findings.disposition: OPEN. Validate degrees of freedom and variance before inference and represent undefined tests explicitly rather than as a zero p-value.

findings.title: No-constant summary reports the wrong Total degrees of freedom and mean square
findings.formula_or_invariant: With uncentered TSS=sum(y^2), Total df is n, and Total MS is TSS/n.
reproduction_steps: Call result.summary() and inspect the Total row; compare its df and MS denominator with n_obs.
findings.disposition: OPEN. Carry the constant convention into summary Total df/MS formatting and add a no-constant summary assertion.
